name: sesame-news
description: Sesame News: API (Backend), back-office (sesame-superadmin) and student app (sesame-user).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix Backend ci && npm --prefix sesame-superadmin ci && npm --prefix sesame-user ci
scripts.lint: npm --prefix Backend run lint && npm --prefix sesame-superadmin run lint && npm --prefix sesame-user run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix Backend test && npm --prefix sesame-superadmin test && npm --prefix sesame-user test
